title: WS-046 - Interpret matrix XML in result exports
intent: Explain how single-choice and multiple-choice matrix answers are represented in EUSurvey XML exports.
short_answer: In XML result exports, a matrix is represented by MatrixTitle, MatrixQuestion rows, MatrixAnswer columns and MatrixCell definitions. Submitted matrix selections are represented by Answer elements that use qid for the row and aid for the selected column. Answers are only given for matrix cells selected by the participant.
procedure: Read MatrixTitle to identify the matrix question.
Map MatrixQuestion entries to matrix rows.
Map MatrixAnswer entries to matrix columns.
Use MatrixCell definitions to understand possible row-column combinations.
In AnswerSet entries, read each Answer qid/aid pair as a selected cell.
important_conditions: The same qid/aid logic applies to both single-choice and multiple-choice matrices.
In multiple-choice matrices, several Answer entries may refer to the same row because multiple columns can be selected.
